summary: Murder conviction based on circumstantial evidence; illicit relationship motive; presence at crime scene established through witness testimony including Section 313 CrPC admission; aluminium phosphide poisoning characteristics debated; suicide theory rejected; testimony contradictions addressed; benefit of doubt extended only to co-accused Rani Kaur; life sentence upheld.
legal_provisions_cited: Jaipal V. State of Haryana - (2003) 1 SCC 169
final_judgment: Appeal dismissed; conviction and life sentence upheld; High Court judgment confirmed.
